facts.text: Undergraduate students entering FGCU as freshmen or sophomores must complete 80 hours of service learning to graduate.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions - Department of Health Sciences
sources.quote: Right now the rule is 80 hours of service learning for students entering FGCU as freshmen and sophomores and 40 hours of service learning for students entering as juniors and seniors

facts.text: All students receiving a baccalaureate degree from FGCU must complete at least three semester hours of sustainability coursework.

sources.title: Undergraduate Requirements - Florida Gulf Coast University
sources.quote: Students receiving a baccalaureate degree from FGCU must complete at least three (3) semester hours of sustainability coursework with a minimum grade of C.
